verses.1: And all the work that Solomon did for the Temple of Jehovah was completed. Then Solomon brought forth the sacred objects of David, his father, as well as gold, silver, and all the other offerings he had made. He placed them in the treasuries of the Temple.
verses.2: Then Solomon will gather together the elders of Israel and all the leaders of the tribes, the chiefs of the fathers among the Israelites, to Jerusalem, so that they may carry the Ark of the Covenant of Jehovah from the city of David, which is Zion.
verses.3: And every man of Israel gathered together before the king on that day, in the fifth month.
verses.4: And all the elders of Israel came and held the lamps.
verses.5: And they carried the altar and the sacred objects that were in it. All of these sacred items were brought there by the priests.
verses.6: And King Solomon and all the tribes of Israel, who were summoned before him, offered sacrifices to God. They offered lambs and grain as offerings, but they did not offer enough or sufficient amounts.
verses.7: And the priests brought the Ark of the Covenant of Jehovah to its place, to Dibir, the house, to the holy place where the sacred things were kept.
verses.8: And the wings of the clouds became like wings, covering the throne. The wings covered both the throne and its surroundings from above.
verses.9: And the cliffs grew longer. The leaders of the cliffs saw from above the mountains, but they did not see the sides. And that place remained in that state until today.
verses.10: There are only two tablets in the Ark, which Moses gave during the conquest of Canaan. These tablets were given by Jehovah to the children of Israel when they left Egypt.
verses.11: And when the priests left the Holy Place, it became clear that all the priests who were found there were indeed holy. They could not be divided among different groups.
verses.12: And the women who are preparing for all this, they gather together to pray and to adorn themselves with flowers. They stand there, facing the altar, along with their priests. There are also about a hundred or twenty houses in the courtyards.
verses.13: And they became one in their singing and praises to God. They sang together, praising the Lord. Their voices echoed throughout the palaces and halls, and in all places where people would sing and praise God. For it is good for ever to praise the Lord; His kindness lasts forever. The house of God is filled with clouds of glory.
verses.14: And the priests were unable to serve from behind the cloud, because the glory of Jehovah filled the Temple.
